text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(It's almost Christmas, huh. What should I 
do this year...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(They've taken care of me for 3 years, 
after all... Maybe I'll ask Trainer about 
their schedule next time.)

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
Please, Dantsu! Come to the Christmas 
party~!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, you should join in too, 
Trainer! We're still pretty short on 
participants this year~!

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
I just mixed everything together this 
year! Like, Trainers, Umamusume, 
instructors—everyone gather 'round! So 
pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, got it! I'll ask my Trainer 
about their schedule too!"

Today is holy Christmas. Invited by Dants 
Flame, I was attending a party held at 
Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Whoa, the Chairwoman's here too! It 
really is a whole jumble of people, huh?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Dantsu! Your dress is so cute~!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Our class is gathering over there. They 
were just about to take a photo. Wanna 
come?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so! Um—
choice_data_list: Don't worry about it, go on ahead.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: "Oh! Trainer <username>! You were here?"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, alright then, I'm off! I'll be right 
back!

While waiting for Dantsu Flame, I ended up 
having a meal with my fellow Trainers.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (I'm late! Where could Trainer be?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ... Ah, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Back in the Junior Class, you used to 
come to me for advice, and look how much 
you've grown now.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, a newly hired Trainer asked me 
to introduce you to them. I think they 
were over that way—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(To think Trainer went to that person to 
consult about their worries...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(............ Have I ever seen her 
troubled like that before...?)

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Dantsu, perfect timing~! I'm so sorry! 
Help me out a sec~!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
I accidentally left the prizes for the 
upcoming raffle back at the dorm! They're 
too heavy for me to carry alone, so could 
someone come with me~?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ... Of course, if you're fine with me!

“—Conversations with my fellow Trainers 
were lively, the food was delicious... and 
before I knew it, quite a bit of time had 
passed.”

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...What's up? Looking for someone?
choice_data_list:
Dantsu Frame is... I'll go look for her a 
bit.

text_block_list.text:
"Feeling somewhat uneasy, I searched all 
over the venue. However, she was nowhere 
to be found—"

text_block_list.name: Christmas Party Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
And with that, it's time to wrap things 
up! To everyone who joined us, thank you 
so very much~!

In the end, the party came to an end 
without me ever finding it...

"Perhaps she already went home ahead with 
her friends. As I started heading back 
anyway—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me! Has the party already ended 
by any chance?
choice_data_list:
Ah, sorry, I thought you'd already gone 
home...
Yeah. Sorry, I thought you'd already left.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I was just cooling off my 
head a bit..."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "Something"...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, well...

A restless atmosphere. Hesitant speech, 
avoided eye contact. Could it be—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: N-No!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san hasn't done anything! Well, if 
you say they haven't done anything, they 
really haven't...
choice_data_list:
'If you say I haven't, then I guess I 
haven't'...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ugh... ah, geez--

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer, you were talking business with 
those people, right?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
You were having a wonderful time with your 
cherished colleague, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's a wonderful thing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: And yet, I—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
... This is... weird, isn't it? Like a 
child.

Though it's rather vague, it seems she had 
been watching the conversation with my 
colleagues for a while.

"...Could it be that I made them feel left 
out?"

In the first place, she was the one who 
invited me to this party. It's certain 
that she truly wanted to spend time 
together.
choice_data_list: Shall we go buy some cake together now?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

Despite it being a party, in the end, we 
couldn't even eat a meal together.

"It's already late, so we won't have much 
time, but I was hoping we could spend a 
quiet moment together reflecting on these 
past three years—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you so much for being so 
thoughtful.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I-It's because I said... something weird, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still... I can't cause you any more 
trouble than this, so...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I'm all right, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Honestly, I'm happy. But... what if I 
end up showing an ugly side of myself...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm fine...! Um... I'll make it up in 
the next training session!"

I watched her trot away as if shaking 
something off, gazing at her back until 
she disappeared from sight.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...B-But, um... the cake shop is already 
closed...
choice_data_list: Let's check out the convenience store.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...A-Are you really sure? I mean, look, 
aren't you cold?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: B-But—
choice_data_list: Right now, I want to eat cake with you.

Right now, I really want to eat cake with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: U-Um... well then, uh—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: "...―― P-Please... ngh."

Afterward, we bought shortcake at the 
convenience store—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! This cake is incredible! It's 
sweet, fluffy, and—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. It's delicious, isn't it!

I was able to spend a warm and pleasant 
time with Dantsu Flame.
